title: Cyrus and the Letters
author: Ines Montrose
blurb: Wendell Dunmore, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
